papers.name: I-Design
papers.method_facts: Multi-agent scene graph, backtracking placement, asset retrieval and rendering. Relational graph, agent dialogue and collision/boundary-aware postprocessing already covered in 2024.
papers.relevant_limit: Paper section9 acknowledges inferred bbox aspect ratios can disagree with retrieved geometry, causing anisotropic scaling distortions and orientation mismatch. This pain is not itself newly discovered by FastFill.
papers.eval_scope: Official script scores five JSON dimensions, repeats three times and saves each mean/std; no overall four-dimension average defined in this file. Paper body often describes four dimensions while appendix prompt lists five; do not infer screenshot incorrect from column count.
papers.novelty_exclusion: Multi-agent+scene graph+placement solver+GPT visual judge is established.

papers.name: SceneReVis
papers.method_facts: Iterative render-diagnose-edit tool loop; SceneChain-12k, SFT then GRPO multi-turn training with geometric and semantic feedback and final physics optimization. Mandatory object verification includes repeated object counts.
papers.inference_budget: Appendix C7 author reports 251s/scene from empty with15iterations and208s from GPT scaffold with10iterations. This is the paper-specific setting, not independently reproduced or directly compared to our timing.
papers.relevant_limit: Appendix E acknowledges iterative latency versus one-pass methods and retrieval/data restrictions; future generative asset integration remains open in that work.
papers.code_scope: Actual VLM/voxel/mesh evaluation files exist; selected functions and thresholds read, not a full paper-code equivalence audit.
papers.novelty_exclusion: Self-reflection, learned/RL correction, mandatory-object checks and a final physics solver are not by themselves new.

papers.name: Global Graph-Validated Optimization for VLM-based 3D Indoor Scene Generation
papers.code_status: No author code link found in inspected paper text and targeted search; not proof that no public code exists.
papers.method_facts: Global Semantic Verification checks relational/feasibility/completeness/semantic graph conflicts with iterative VLM refinement. Global Physical Feasibility Search combines evolutionary exploration and gradient refinement.
papers.inference_budget: Paper implementation: population50, retain5;30generations for<10objects else50; top5 refined for200gradient steps; choose minimum energy. Not a lightweight single proposal.
papers.eval_scope: Paper follows33scenes/11types LayoutVLM setup and also reports SceneEval-100; no results independently reproduced here.
papers.relevant_limit: Paper admits stochastic GPT selection/quantity/evaluation and inconsistent assets/oversized/render failures. Asset pre-check is a suggested improvement already, so cannot be claimed as our novelty.
papers.novelty_exclusion: Global graph validation, conflict-driven reflection and hybrid global/local geometric optimization have direct 2026 precedent.
